evidence.description: The prepared score panel then merges distinct lead-score, accounting, market-cap and additional accounting inputs.
evidence.quote:
merge 1:1 isin file_year using "scores_lead_def.dta", gen(_merge)
drop if _merge == 2
drop _merge

// variables for Tables 6-8
g delta_TotalScore = (TotalScore_lead1 - TotalScore)
sort Country isin file_year 
g delta_PartA = (PartA_lead1 - PartA)
sort Country isin file_year 
g delta_PartB = (PartB_lead1 - PartB)
sort Country isin file_year 
g delta_PartC = (PartC_lead1 - PartC)
sort Country isin file_year 
g delta_PartD = (PartD_lead1 - PartD)
sort Country isin file_year 
g delta_PartE = (PartE_lead1 - PartE)

// lags Top Lists
sort Country isin file_year 
by Country isin: g pre_top50_1lag = 1 if treatment[_n-1] == 1 
replace pre_top50_1lag = 0 if pre_top50_1lag==.

// Accounting Variables
merge 1:1 isin file_year using Accounting_vars.dta, gen(_merge_wd) // in t-1
drop if _merge_wd == 2 
drop if _merge_wd == 1 
g LEV2 = Tot_Liabilities / Tot_Assets
g SIZE = log(1+Tot_Assets)
g ROA = NI / Tot_Assets	
g ROE = NI / CEQ
g SALES_TA = SALES / Tot_Assets

// Market Cap
merge 1:1 isin file_year using Mkt_vars.dta, gen(_merge_ds) // in t-1
drop if _merge_ds == 2
drop if _merge_ds == 1
g log_mkt = log(mkt)

local var LEV2 SIZE ROA ROE MTB log_mkt Tot_Assets SALES NI SALES_TA CEQ Tot_Liabilities
foreach y of local var {
winsor `y', gen(w1_`y') p(0.01)
winsor `y', gen(w5_`y') p(0.05)
}
drop _merge*
compress

merge 1:1 isin file_year using Accounting_vars__II.dta, gen(_merge__II) // in t and t+1

evidence.description: The share-count preparation branch reads a separately named author table and parses a date field.
evidence.quote:
use "number_shares_tempI.dta", clear
g datevar = date(date_s, "DMY")
format datevar %d

bysort year month isin: egen max_datevar = max(datevar)
format max_datevar %d

g quarter = 1 if month =="jan" | month =="feb" | month =="mar"
replace quarter = 2 if month =="apr" | month =="may" | month =="jun"
replace quarter = 3 if month =="jul" | month =="aug" | month =="sep"
replace quarter = 4 if month =="oct" | month =="nov" | month =="dec"

bysort year quarter isin: egen max_datevarDEF = max(max_datevar)

evidence.description: The stock-price branch reads a distinct daily file, derives market-adjusted returns and event-window cumulative returns, then saves a CAR panel.
evidence.quote:
use "stock_price_data.dta", clear

// gen firm returns
sort isin datevar
by isin: g ret_firm = log(price/price[_n-1])
replace ret_firm = 0 if ret_firm==.

g adj_ret = ret_firm - ret_mkt

* CAR[0]
sort isin datevar
g car_1 = adj_ret

* CAR[0,1]
sort isin datevar
by isin: g car_3 = adj_ret + adj_ret[_n+1]

* CAR[-3,3]
sort isin datevar
by isin: g car_5 = adj_ret + adj_ret[_n+1] + adj_ret[_n-1] + adj_ret[_n-2] + adj_ret[_n-3] + adj_ret[_n+2] + adj_ret[_n+3]

keep if (datevar == event_2012) | (datevar == event_2013) | (datevar == event_2014) | (datevar == event_2015) | (datevar == event_2017)
bysort isin file_year: g ok = 1 if file_year==file_year[_n+1]
keep if ok ==.
compress
save "car.dta", replace

evidence.description: The supplied program reads World Governance Indicators for a specified year and creates a country-level regulatory-quality/rule-of-law variable.
evidence.quote:
cd "[redacted-path-95daac1b8eca]"
use "wgidataset.dta" // Regulatory Quality and Rule of Law
keep if year == 2010
keep if countryname =="Indonesia" | ///
countryname =="Malaysia" | ///
countryname =="Philippines" | ///
countryname =="Singapore" | ///
countryname =="Thailand" | ///
countryname =="Vietnam"
br countryname rqe rle
tab rqe 
tab rle
rename countryname Country
keep Country rqe rle
g high_rle = 1 if Country=="Malaysia" | Country=="Singapore" // Cross-sectional variable for Table 3 Panel A

evidence.description: The final stage merges the WGI country table and a separate analyst-following table, then saves the supplied preparation endpoint.
evidence.quote:
cd "[redacted-path-95daac1b8eca]"
use "ASEAN_working_fileIII.dta", clear

// Cross-sectional variable for Table 3 Panel A
merge m:1 Country using "wgidataset_cleaned.dta", gen(_merge_d)
drop if _merge_d == 2
drop _merge_d

// number of analysts
merge m:1 isin file_year using "following_def_DEF.dta", gen(_merge_d)
drop if _merge_d == 2
drop _merge_d

replace tot_following = 0 if tot_following ==.

	g high_following =. // Cross-sectional variable for Table 3 Panel B
	forval i = 1/25 { // by country-year
	su tot_following if year_country_fe == `i', d
	g high_following`i' = 1 if tot_following>=r(p50) & year_country_fe == `i'
	replace high_following`i' = 0 if high_following`i'  ==. & year_country_fe == `i' 
	replace high_following =  high_following`i' if year_country_fe == `i'
	}

save "ASEAN_final_file.dta", replace

actions.description: Obtain the release-specific producer, compatible prepared file or authorized route, schema, keys and coverage for the fifteen unresolved non-WGI direct inputs. Stage WGI through its verified public route using A_WGI_PUBLIC_PREPARATION; do not use a broken catalog helper or undocumented raw-source reconstruction to infer availability.
steps: Resolve these fifteen named inputs separately: data_2012_2017_1_all.xls; data_2017_on_all.xls; factset_data.dta; factset_dataII.dta; fuzzy_matching_def_cleaned_isin.dta; fuzzy_matching_def_cleaned_isin_2017.dta; _merge_d_2012_2017.dta; _merge_d_2017.dta; scores_lead_def.dta; Accounting_vars.dta; Mkt_vars.dta; Accounting_vars__II.dta; number_shares_tempI.dta; stock_price_data.dta; and following_def_DEF.dta.
Acquire and stage the verified public WGI standard-unit estimates through the separate WGI action; reuse the source-coded 2010 country filters, Country rename and spelling adjustment.
Keep the ACGS editions, FactSet extracts, fuzzy crosswalks and manual updates as separate source stages.
validation: Map every direct read in the 78-event ordered workflow trace to a supplied input or a specifically documented producer.
Confirm no missing input remains grouped under a generic placeholder and no required branch is omitted.

actions.description: Request the two author-prepared ACGS score/Top 50 workbooks through the authors' documented access route, together with the field definitions and edition coverage needed by each branch. The datasheet describes the score/ranking data as proprietary author-supplied material.
steps: Obtain DATA ASEAN/data_2012_2017_1_all.xls and DATA ASEAN/data_2017_on_all.xls as distinct prepared inputs or receive an author-documented compatible replacement for each.
Request the workbook schemas, score definitions, edition/year coverage and authorized handling terms; do not infer an open download route from the source description.
validation: Check that each workbook has the Sheet1 and header layout expected by its separate import and supports the corresponding edition branch.
Verify the imported keys and score fields against the downstream merge/reshape statements without exposing row-level identifiers.

actions.description: Request the distinct author-prepared FactSet/LionShares extracts and their schemas through an authorized documented route. A product/catalog miss does not establish that either vendor source is unavailable or that this environment has no entitlement.
steps: Obtain factset_data.dta for the early edition branch and factset_dataII.dta for the distinct 2017 branch, or obtain separate documented compatible prepared extracts.
Request the field dictionary, download-vintage notes, identifier/date conventions and authorized access conditions for each table.
validation: Check required firm/time/ownership fields and coverage for the source-coded event windows, including the prior history used by the transformations.
Preserve both branch inputs and the code's separate manual-update handoffs.

actions.description: Request both edition-specific fuzzy matching crosswalks and both manual unmatched-observation update files, plus the matching/update rules that created them.
steps: Obtain fuzzy_matching_def_cleaned_isin.dta and fuzzy_matching_def_cleaned_isin_2017.dta as separate prepared inputs with source and decision documentation.
Obtain _merge_d_2012_2017.dta and _merge_d_2017.dta with the author-described unmatched-observation update semantics and edition-specific fields.
validation: Check the expected company-name/ISIN and merge-key columns, branch assignment and join behavior from the supplied code.
Record matching decisions and manual-update provenance without printing row-level identifier values.

actions.description: Request scores_lead_def.dta or the exact author-specified construction of its lead score fields; this table is directly consumed but has no producer in the supplied do-file.
steps: Request the table's ACGS edition source, score-column dictionary, lead-year convention, key definition and producer steps.
Use the author-prepared table if supplied rather than inferring a lead transformation from unrelated files.
validation: Check the required isin/file_year merge and lead-score fields against the downstream score-change calculations.
Confirm that source years and edition branches line up with the author's declared lead convention.

actions.description: Request the author-prepared accounting and market-variable tables with their complete producer and field-mapping notes. The registered catalog contains plausible Datastream/Worldscope raw candidates, but catalog metadata alone does not show live readability or establish the author's firm, year, currency, measure and lag/lead transformations.
steps: Request Accounting_vars.dta, Mkt_vars.dta and Accounting_vars__II.dta as the primary author-prepared inputs, with variable definitions and t−1/t/t+1 year conventions.

If the author documents a raw-source alternative, resolve the Worldscope code-to-ISIN mapping and identify the appropriate fields/measures, including income choice, currency, units and fiscal-year timing.
Treat TRWS.WRDS_WS_FUNDA, TRWS.WRDS_WS_COMPANY and TR_DS.DS2MKTVAL only as catalog-listed candidates; do not assume access or map their columns without author or source documentation.
validation: Confirm all required output fields map to the source-coded calculations and preserve the separate lag/current/lead table roles.
Check key coverage, currency and unit conventions, fiscal-year alignment and the code's t−1/t/t+1 requirements before building the tables.

actions.description: Request number_shares_tempI.dta and its author-described producer as the primary route. The registered Datastream market-value table is a candidate for a documented alternative, not a verified substitute.
steps: Obtain the prepared shares table or a complete authorized transformation from the catalog-listed TR_DS.DS2MKTVAL fields.
For any raw alternative, document the InfoCode-to-ISIN map, ValDate selection, consolidated share measure and the table's thousands scaling.
validation: Check date and firm coverage for the program's quarterly mean/median windows and t−4 through t+4 quarters.
Confirm units and keys before merging the generated shares panel into the main working file.

actions.description: Request stock_price_data.dta and its exact producer, including the source for the market-return field and the event-date mappings. Catalogued Datastream quote/return-index tables are candidates only and do not establish the prepared input contract.
steps: Obtain the prepared daily firm price/return table or an author-documented compatible construction from TR_DS.DS2PRIMQTPRC and, if appropriate, TR_DS.DS2PRIMQTRI.
Resolve the security-to-ISIN mapping, exchange/currency and price-selection rules, market return series and each branch's event-date fields.
validation: Verify daily coverage of event-date rows, the previous observation used for returns and the authored cumulative-return window.
Check all required stock_price_data.dta columns and the produced car.dta join key before merging.

actions.description: Acquire the verified public 2026 WGI Stata product and stage its annual standard-unit estimates into the fields used by master_file.do. The supplied source already handles the required country selection and Country spelling conversion.
steps: Acquire the catalog-listed public WGI 2026 Stata product when staging the full inputs; no access request or original-byte match is needed.
Select the standard-statistical-unit estimates for Regulatory Quality and Rule of Law, then reshape/rename the current source fields into the code's expected year, countryname, rqe and rle structure.
Retain the supplied 2010 country filter, countryname-to-Country rename and Philippines spelling adjustment in master_file.do.
validation: Check the staged input has the required 2010 standard-unit estimates for both indicators and the source-coded country set.
Confirm the staged fields support the existing do-file country operations and preserve the named ASEAN_final_file.dta endpoint.
Record that the 2026 release recalculates historical values and may change output values; treat this as an output-fidelity note, not an access, compatibility or byte-identity gate.

actions.description: Request following_def_DEF.dta and its source/product and construction specification; the package and supplied do-file do not define the provenance of tot_following.
steps: Obtain the prepared table or exact author-approved producer, including analyst-following field definition, reporting period and any threshold inputs.
Preserve the source-coded isin/file_year merge and country-year high/low construction.
validation: Check the required keys and tot_following field against the final merge.
Confirm the median-group construction inputs and period before preparing the final output.

review_notes: The assessment follows the full supplied preparation workflow and stops at ASEAN_final_file.dta; the do-file contains no final regression or table-estimation endpoint.
The packaged list_identifiers.xls is separately identified in the datasheet but is not consumed by master_file.do, so it is not a required analysis input.

The sixteen named direct input files are absent. WGI has a verified public current route; fifteen other inputs remain unresolved. Datastream and Worldscope catalog entries are raw candidates only; catalog metadata does not establish live access or author-specific construction.

The official WGI product includes annual standard-unit estimates, 2010 is in coverage, and the code supplies its country selection/rename/spelling operations. The 2026 release recalculates history and may change output values; this is an output-fidelity note rather than an access, compatibility or byte-identity gate.
All source edits are proposals only. The working copy retains both ACGS editions, both ownership branches, manual updates, all preparation stages and the supplied final dataset endpoint.
